pages.title: Higgsfield CLI | AI Image & Video Generation for Any Agent
pages.visible_text: Explore Image Video Audio Supercomputer New MCP & CLI New Collab Marketing Studio Cinema Studio AI Influencer Canvas Apps Pricing 30% OFF Login Sign up TURN CHATGPT INTO A CREATIVE ENGINE Connect Higgsfield to Claude, OpenClaw, Hermes, NemoClaw and generate cinematic images and videos right from your conversations. MCP CLI Skill Github 1 Install the CLI One line — auth, uploads, and polling are handled for you. npm install -g @higgsfield/cli 2 Sign in Opens a browser, takes 5 seconds. Run higgsfield auth login and you're authenticated. higgsfield auth login 3 Plug skills into your agent Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and 12+ other agents. Then just say: "Generate an image with Higgsfield." npx skills add higgsfield-ai/skills THE COMMAND SET auth · account Device-code OAuth, credit balance, transactions, and team-workspace switching. auth account workspace version model Live catalog of all 35+ models. Inspect parameter schemas, defaults, and enums. list get generate The workhorse. Submit, estimate cost, wait, fetch, and list jobs across every model. create cost wait get list upload Push an image, video, or audio file. Returns a UUID to plug into any generation. image video audio soul-id Train a face-faithful identity from 3–5 reference photos. create wait list marketing-studio Score engagement, hook strength, retention risk, and creative performance. virality_predictor A COMPLETE CREATIVE STUDIO INSIDE CLAUDE Image generation, video creation, character training, and asset management in a single connection GENERATIVE MEDIA IMAGE & VIDEO GENERATION From static stills to full cinematic video - choose your model, set the parameters, and generate. Soul and Nano Banana for images. Seedance, Kling, Veo for video. Up to 4K, any aspect ratio, any duration. AD ENGINE ONE PROMPT REPLACES YOUR ENTIRE AGENCY Finds top-spending niches, generates videos across formats UGC, TV spot, Wild Card - writes outreach, and delivers a weekly report. Replaces a $5K/mo retainer - from one brief. MODES PICK A FORMAT, SKIP THE SETUP Choose from 10+ ready-made modes - product shots, lifestyle scenes, hero banners, Pinterest pins, ad packs and more. Claude picks the right preset and passes it into generation automatically. BRAND BUILDER FROM ZERO TO A PROFITABLE BRAND Finds an underserved product, sources a factory, generates listing photos and hero video, mines reviews for counter-narrative ads, builds the D2C site. A COMPLETE CREATIVE STUDIO INSIDE YOUR AGENT Image generation, video creation, character training, and asset management in a single connection Every marketing asset Turn any product into a campaign in seconds. Drop a URL or photo, pick a format - Marketing Studio handles the rest. Posters, ads, lifestyle shots, social posts - whatever the channel needs. Your brand, inside every prompt Connect Marketing Studio to Claude or any MCP client. Your brand kit - colors, fonts, tone of voice - loads automatically with every generation. No re-uploading, no drift. On-brand by default. Automated content for any niche Pulls listings or trends, generates a polished video per item, and distributes via WhatsApp, YouTube, or wherever your audience lives. A full channel on autopilot - zero agency fees. Engagement score One number for how long people will actually watch. Not a guess, not a vibe check - a modeled read on whether your clip earns the scroll or loses it. The closest thing to a test screening before you hit publish. FROM CONCEPT TO CONTENT IN ONE CONVERSATION Tell Claude what you're working on. It picks the right models and delivers production-ready results E-COMMERCE & PRODUCT Generate lifestyle product shots, swap backgrounds, and create promotional videos without a photo studio. Describe your product and scene, and Claude delivers ready-to-publish visuals. SOCIAL MEDIA & CONTENT CREATION Produce scroll-stopping images and short-form videos for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. Go from idea to post in a single conversation. MARKETING AGENCIES Scale campaign visuals across formats, styles, and models in minutes. Generate dozens of variations, compare outputs, and deliver client-ready assets from one conversation. FILMMAKING Storyboard scenes, generate concept art, previsualize shots, and produce cinematic video clips. Use Soul Characters to maintain cast consistency across every frame. INFOGRAPHICS & VISUAL DATA Turn dry numbers into compelling visuals. Generate custom illustrations, icons, and supporting imagery that bring your data stories to life. FROM IDEA TO CAMPAIGN IN ONE CONVERSATION Start small with a quick generation, or go deep with multi-model comparisons, character training, and full campaign workflows. Claude handles the complexity Asset Creation Generate one asset in seconds Describe what you need and Claude picks the best model, sets the parameters, and delivers the result. Images, videos, or both. Generate a cinematic wide shot of a neon-lit Tokyo alley at night Full Production Build a visual system from a conversation Train a character, generate scenes across locations and styles, produce videos, and manage everything from your generation history. Train a Soul Character from these photos, then generate a 10-image lookbook Multi-Model Compare the best AI models side by side Run the same prompt through Flux, Soul, Cinema Studio, and Seedream in one go. Pick the winner and iterate from there. Generate this scene on 4 different models and show me the results GOT ANY QUESTIONS LEFT? We’ve answered the most frequently asked questions How does Higgsfield connect to AI agents? Which agents are supported? What models are available? What can I create? Do I need an API key? How does pricing work? How long does generation take? Can I use previous generations as input? Can I use Higgsfield with my own agent setup? YOUR AI STACK JUST LEVELED UP Connect Claude, OpenClaw, Hermes, or NemoClaw to Higgsfield in seconds. Videos, images, characters — on demand.
